title: pre-commit boundary hook silently skips inside a git worktree: --show-toplevel is the worktree, so ../prusik-hq is never found
detail: scripts pre-commit hook resolves REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); in worktrees/<role> that is the worktree, so $REPO/../prusik-hq/hq/products.local.json does not exist and the hook prints 'boundary gate SKIPPED' and allows the commit (rc 0). Every sprint commit made in a worktree skips the open-core boundary gate. Fix: resolve the main checkout via $(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)/.. before probing for the sibling HQ.
